assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The appeal is for episode ep-05050
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events
The denial is based on the required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained
The appeal is for the outstanding balance of 634.27
